subject: CONTRACT setThreadgroupMemoryLength (dynamic [[threadgroup(n)]]): already exact via SpecKey::TgLength -> WLS; no compiler change; host-tested on real APL kernels
body:
Finding: the translator lowers each Metal dynamic threadgroup argument n to a Workgroup array whose length is SpecConstantOp of the specialization SpecKey::TgLength(n) (words = max(8, align16(len)/4)); metal2vulkan bind/plan/compute.rs fills TgLength(n) from KernelState.threadgroup_lengths rounded to 16 (TG_ALIGN). compile_compute_v2 (lib 1877804b, compute source 19f5e3f8, unchanged) consumes it as an ordinary per-region uint32 specialization and reports the resulting per-workgroup WLS in TGP2 header word18 (sum of all dynamic + static threadgroup memory; >32KiB refused rc4 'TGP2 workgroup memory exceeds 32KiB').
Host evidence (check_compute_v2_memory.py ab33be17, gpu/build/lowering-claude-20261025/final-1877804b/memory-tg, 24/24): real QuartzCore SPIR-V compute_apl (TgLength SpecId5), compute_apl_fast (SpecId5), sum_apl_and_compute_dimming_factor (SpecId4): len 0->wls32, 16->32, 48->48, 100->112, 1024->1024, 4096->4096, 16384->16384, 32768->32768, 32784/40000 refused. ISA uses LOAD/STORE .wls + BARRIER (e.g. compute_apl@1024: 27 wls loads, 27 wls stores, 18 BARRIER).
REQUIRED in compute (owner air_bridge.rs/compute_frontend.m/bridge):
1. Encoder: setThreadgroupMemoryLength:atIndex: records length per index (Metal: multiple of 16, <= maxThreadgroupMemoryLength 32768; refuse otherwise), default 0 per dispatch encoder state.
2. Planner: put those lengths into BindState kernel threadgroup_lengths before tegu_air_pipeline_plan_dispatch so the TgLength SpecKeys get the real values in EVERY region's constants (do not leave the default 0: default 0 compiles a 32-byte array and the kernel would index out of its threadgroup buffer). Variant/region cache key = full constant table (already includes these values).
3. Bridge: allocate WLS from packet word18 per my TLS/WLS recipe (wls_instances via pan_calc_wls_instances, size scale log2(pan_wls_adjust_size)+1, BO >= pan_calc_total_wls_size). Keep allow_merging_workgroups 0.
No new manifest record is needed because the size is fully specialized into each compiled package; the length is part of the identity, not a runtime field. Host-only, GPU_EXECUTED=0.
